episodes.title: Episode 67 | From Cult Escape to Cavalry Sergeant: Combat, Trauma, & Survival | Frez’s Story
episodes.description:
In this deeply moving, raw, and sometimes humorous episode, we sit down with Todd Fresi ("FREZ"), a former Cavalry Sergeant who served 14 years and eight months in the Australian Army. Frez opens up about a childhood defined by extreme psychological, physical, and spiritual abuse inside a strict religious cult, a place where fear, manipulation, and forced street preaching dominated his early psyche.  

Frez recounts how he used the Army Reserves at just 16 years old as a literal escape hatch to build a completely new life, effectively viewing his enlistment date as his true birthday. He details transitioning to the regular army, deploying on high-tempo tours to Afghanistan as an ASLAV driver, and navigating intense combat zones marked by close calls with pressure-plate IEDs and targeted rocket attacks.  

Beyond the battlefield, Frez bravely confronts the hidden costs of his service: the severe trauma triggered by witnessing the localized abuse of women and children overseas, a downward spiral into alcoholism, and his own agonizing battles with suicide attempts post-service. He reflects on the power of exposure therapy, escaping the "broken veteran" stigma, and how anchoring his daily purpose in physical fitness, calisthenics, and a strict diet completely rewired his mental health.
